works.gap: Fixed-field definitions describe this historical manual and an adopted-data convention. Preserve each primary paper's empirical status, operator sign, dataset lineage, and cited evidence independently. Low-level PDF character extraction has encoding defects.
works.lineage: One BNL/NNDC report. Examples illustrate evaluated and decay files, without duplicating their underlying experiments.
